title: Drag Bar Crawl with Drink in Los Angeles
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our adventure begins at a favorite dive bar, where your glamorous drag guide greets you. Enjoy your first round of drinks (on us!) and get to know your host as we set off on a West Hollywood crawl.

At our first stop, your charismatic guide shares stories about the history and culture of WeHo. Leading you to three of their favorite bars, each with its unique vibe, you'll experience everything from chic lounges to lively dance spots.

As we hop from bar to bar, you'll meet local drag queens and hear insider stories about iconic WeHo bars, both famous and local. Your guide will make you feel like a true WeHo insider.

The night ends at your host's home bar in West Hollywood, where the energy is electric. Hit the dance floor and enjoy the vibrant, welcoming spirit that defines WeHo.

This drag bar crawl is a celebration of life, diversity, and the vibrant energy of LA's iconic LGBTQ+ neighborhood. Come alone, leave with friends, and create unforgettable memories!
